# railway_service_instance (Resource)

Manages a Railway service instance in one environment, including its source, deployment settings, and resource limits. Omitted attributes reset to Railway defaults. Removing this resource deletes the environment instance without deleting the project-level service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_service_instance" "api" {
  environment_id   = railway_environment.preview.id
  service_id       = railway_service.api.id
  source_image     = "traefik/whoami:v1.10"
  healthcheck_path = "/"
  vcpus            = 0.5
  memory_gb        = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment.
- `service_id` (String) Identifier of the service.

### Optional

- `config_path` (String) Path to the Railway configuration file used by this service instance.
- `cron_schedule` (String) Cron schedule for this service instance. Only allowed when the total number of replicas across all regions is `1`.
- `healthcheck_path` (String) HTTP path Railway uses to check this service instance. Omit to disable the healthcheck.
- `healthcheck_timeout` (Number) Maximum healthcheck duration in seconds. Omit or set to zero to reset the timeout.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory in GB allocated to this service instance. Omit or set to zero to reset the memory override.
- `regions` (Attributes Map) Region and replica overrides for this service instance. Omit to let Railway choose the effective placement. After import, configure this attribute explicitly to retain the existing placement as an override. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))
- `root_directory` (String) Root directory used to build this service instance.
- `source_image` (String) Container image used by this service instance. Omit to disconnect the image source.
- `source_image_registry_password` (String, Sensitive) Password used to pull the service instance image from a private registry.
- `source_image_registry_username` (String) Username used to pull the service instance image from a private registry.
- `source_repo` (String) Source repository used by this service instance.
- `source_repo_branch` (String) Repository branch deployed by this service instance.
- `start_command` (String) Command used to start this service instance. Omit to reset the command override.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs allocated to this service instance. Omit or set to zero to reset the CPU override.

### Read-Only

- `effective_regions` (Attributes Map) Regions and replica counts currently present in Railway's environment configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective_regions))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the service instance.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project containing the service and environment.

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Optional:

- `num_replicas` (Number) Number of replicas to deploy.


<a id="nestedatt--effective_regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective_regions`

Read-Only:

- `num_replicas` (Number) Effective number of replicas.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import railway_service_instance.api environment_id:service_id
```
